# Why this section exists

A notebook that trains once on a laptop is not a system. MLOps is the unglamorous half: how the code is structured, how a run is repeated, how a model is evaluated after training, and how serving differs from training.

# What will live here

Pages I intend to write, not pages that exist today:

- How to structure ML code (the [labs index](/labs/labs-index.qmd) already bookmarks an external note on this; it should become a real page).
- Train versus serve.
- Evaluation in the loop, pointing at [Model evaluation](/evaluation/evaluation-index.qmd).
- Versioning of data, code and models, in plain language.

Nothing above is written yet.
